methodology.notes: Local run of the legal domain with the higher-order legal-harness Claude plugin (--agent claude_harness, Architecture B). Agent base model = aws/claude-sonnet-4-5 via the IBM LiteLLM proxy (Anthropic /v1/messages path); user-sim = aws/claude-sonnet-4-5; judge = aws/claude-opus-4-8. submission_type is 'custom' because the agent scaffold (skills + scripts + PreToolUse hooks over the legal MCP server) is non-standard.
